clauses.clause_label: 一、个人与开源用途——免费
clauses.scope_note: The permission covers use, copying, modification, and distribution of the software and derivative works only in one of the stated personal-learning/research/evaluation, personal noncommercial-creation, or qualifying open-source-project contexts. Open-source use requires an OSI-approved license and publication of complete source code. The stated notice condition applies across these permitted uses. Decks generated using the software are separately described as unrestricted by this license for their use.
clauses.condition_explanation: At least one listed use context must apply. For the open-source alternative, the project must use an OSI-approved license and publish complete source code. In all cases, the license and copyright notice must be retained in source code or documentation.

clauses.clause_label: 个人非商业创作：生成的演示/deck作品
clauses.scope_note: The license states that the presentation/deck works generated with the software belong to the user and may be used freely, without restriction under this license, including commercially. This concerns generated deck works, not use or redistribution of the software itself.
clauses.condition_explanation: No additional condition is stated for use of the generated deck works.

clauses.clause_label: 二、闭源/商业用途——需购买商业授权
clauses.scope_note: Using the software, a derivative, or a substantial part in closed-source software, a closed-source service, SaaS, a product that does not publish its source, a directly profit-motivated commercial product or service, or an equivalent closed-source commercial scenario requires a paid written commercial license obtained in advance. The accompanying clarification says the generated deck itself may be used commercially freely; authorization is needed for embedding the software itself in a closed-source/commercial product for redistribution. The text does not provide the terms of any separately negotiated commercial license.
clauses.condition_explanation: The restriction applies when the software, a derivative, or a substantial part is used in one of the specified closed-source or commercial scenarios and no written commercial license was obtained beforehand.

coverage_notes: The Chinese text controls over the English summary; the Chinese operative clauses are cited. The commercial-license terms are not supplied, so no permissions or conditions under that separate license are inferred.
The license does not state a general grant for uses outside the expressly listed free-use contexts, nor does that silence establish a blanket prohibition on unrelated activities or artifacts.
Warranty and liability disclaimers are omitted as unrelated to the requested activity/subject/constraint clauses.
